words.sense: wretchedly dirty and neglected physical conditions
misconceptions: Treating reprehensible conduct as though it meant physical filth.
Treating extreme physical neglect as proof of unethical behavior.

semantic_axes.description: Squalid describes miserable physical dirt and neglect; sordid describes shameful, morally ugly acts or dealings.

edges.boundary_rule: Squalid describes miserable physical dirt and neglect; sordid describes shameful, morally ugly acts or dealings.

misconceptions.M1: Confuses squalid with sordid by overlooking the defining difference: Squalid describes miserable physical dirt and neglect; sordid describes shameful, morally ugly acts or dealings.
misconceptions.M2: Assumes evidence for sordid necessarily proves squalid; these are different tests.
misconceptions.M3: Overweights a later superficial detail instead of retaining or appropriately updating the original boundary evidence.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the condition of Zain’s rented room?

beats.text: Zain’s rented room had mold across the walls, a blocked toilet and a soaked mattress.
beats.decisive_clue: severe physical dirt and neglected facilities
beats.reason: The room is materially filthy and unfit for comfort.

beats.text: He also found old food decomposing beneath the bed.
beats.decisive_clue: rotting food compounds the neglected conditions
beats.reason: The added decay makes the physical neglect unmistakable.

chains.feedback_short: Rotting food compounds the neglected conditions; the added decay makes the physical neglect unmistakable.
chains.feedback_deep: Squalid means wretchedly dirty and neglected physical conditions; sordid means morally shameful or sleazy conduct. The added decay makes the physical neglect unmistakable.
chains.contrast_rule: Squalid describes miserable physical dirt and neglect; sordid describes shameful, morally ugly acts or dealings.

hints.attention: Look at the actual state of the room.
hints.axis: Squalid describes miserable physical dirt and neglect; sordid describes shameful, morally ugly acts or dealings.
hints.contrast: Squalid describes miserable physical dirt and neglect; sordid describes shameful, morally ugly acts or dealings.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the scheme Bea uncovered?

beats.text: Bea found that a seller forged customers’ signatures to keep their refunds.
beats.reason: The wrongdoing is an ethical violation, not a description of a dirty room.

beats.text: The seller hid the stolen money in a private account.
beats.decisive_clue: concealment of the proceeds of exploitation
beats.reason: Hiding the gains confirms the scheme’s corrupt nature.

chains.feedback_short: Concealment of the proceeds of exploitation; hiding the gains confirms the scheme’s corrupt nature.

beats.text: Dina’s station stairwell was littered with rubbish and had stagnant water across the steps.
beats.decisive_clue: extreme accumulated filth in a neglected public stairwell
beats.reason: The key is severe neglect of the physical surroundings.

beats.text: Its handrail had once been painted green.
beats.decisive_clue: extreme accumulated filth in a neglected public stairwell
beats.reason: An old paint color does not make the description about dishonesty.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the rental scheme Rina discovered?

beats.text: Rina discovered that an agent took deposits for apartments he had no authority to rent.
beats.decisive_clue: deceptive collection of money for unavailable rentals
beats.reason: The scheme is shameful because people are deliberately deceived.

beats.text: He repeatedly instructed applicants not to contact the actual owners.
beats.decisive_clue: effort to conceal the false authority from applicants
beats.reason: Discouraging contact with owners strengthens the evidence of fraud.
